verdict.rationale: Angular is a framework whose source is published on GitHub. Its CLI creates workspaces, builds and serves apps locally, and deploys them via a deploy builder, so the core product runs entirely on infrastructure you control with no vendor-hosted dependency. missing for 10: explicit open-source license documentation in the evidence, any guidance on self-hosting ancillary tooling or resources, independent hands-on corroboration of a fully self-contained setup.
